tests.name: Power Frequency Magnetic Field Immunity Test
tests.setup: EUT placed on GRP insulated by 0.1m insulating support; GRP on 0.8m wooden table for tabletop equipment; induction coil 1m×1m; immersion method; coil rotated 90° for orthogonal orientations
tests.result: EUT does not contain magnetic sensing components or circuits; exempt from this test per Table 4 Remark d

requirements.title: Risks from reasonably foreseeable electromagnetic disturbances
requirements.requirement: Risks resulting from reasonably foreseeable electromagnetic disturbances taken into account in the risk management process.

requirements.title: Non-ME equipment used in ME system
requirements.requirement: Non-ME equipment used in an ME system shall comply with IEC and ISO EMC standards applicable to that equipment.
requirements.result_remark: EUT does not contain non-ME equipment.

requirements.title: Configurations
requirements.requirement: ME equipment and ME systems tested in representative configurations consistent with intended use, most likely to result in unacceptable risk.
requirements.result_remark: See Chapter 5.3 and RMF Reference Document: PT9L-FXPJ01 V1.0

requirements.title: Marking for shielded location special environment
requirements.requirement: ME equipment and ME systems specified for use only in a shielded location shall be labelled with a clearly legible warning.
requirements.result_remark: The EUT does not specify use only in a shielded location special environment.

sub_items.requirement: A statement of the environments for which the ME equipment or ME system is suitable. Relevant exclusions determined by risk analysis are listed.
The essential performance of ME equipment and a description of what the operator can expect if the essential performance is lost or degraded due to EM disturbances.
A warning regarding stacking and location close to other equipment.

products.notes: Does not contain magnetic sensing components or circuits; does not contain non-ME equipment; not specified for use only in a shielded location

semantic_fragments.content: The EUT was placed on a ground reference plane (GRP) insulated by an insulating support 0.1m thick and the GRP was placed on a 0.8m high wooden table for table-top equipment. For floor standing equipment, the EUT was placed on a 0.1m high wooden support above the GRP. The EUT was configured and connected to satisfy its functional requirements. The power supply, input and output circuits was connected to the sources of power supply, control and signal. The cables supplied or recommended by the equipment manufacturer were used. In absence of any recommendation, unshielded cables were adopted, of a type appropriate for the signals involved. All cables were exposed to the magnetic field for 1m of their length. The EUT was subjected to the test magnetic field by using the induction coil of standard dimensions (1m×1m) by the immersion method. The induction coil was then be rotated by 90° in order to expose the EUT to the test field with different orientations. For floor-standing equipment the test was repeated by moving and shifting the induction coils, in order to test the whole volume of the EUT for each orthogonal direction.

IEC 60601-1-2:2014+A1:2020/EN 60601-1-2:2015+A1:2021 Table 4 Remark d Applies only to ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEMS with magnetically sensitive components or circuitry. The EUT does not contain magnetic sensing components or circuits (see Annex statement) and exempt from this test.
